meta.title: ACCT 321 — Scope Configuration
meta.description: Scope decisions for the Accounting Cycle Practice Tool. These control what the webapp presents and validates.

compound_entries.note: Start with simple 2-account entries only. Each transaction has exactly one debit and one credit.

rules: Account names must match exactly (case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed)
Debit and credit amounts must match exactly
Total debits must equal total credits for each entry
Partial credit is not awarded — the entry is either correct or incorrect
answer_checking.note: Exact match on accounts + amounts. No partial credit in v1.

business_types.note: Both service and merchandising transactions are included. Students should be told which type they are practicing.

entity_types.note: Both entity types included. Worked examples specify the entity type.

beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.description: Basic cash transactions, simple services, single-step

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: Depreciation, bad debts, notes, compound entries (future)
